sonuc.drug_name: Entresto 24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, 97 mg/103 mg film-coated tablets

what_for.text: Entresto treats a type of long-term heart failure in adults.
what_for.evidence: Entresto is used to treat a type of long-term heart failure in adults, children and adolescents (one year and older).

how_to_use.text: You will usually take one tablet in the morning and one in the evening.
how_to_use.evidence: You will usually start by taking a 24 mg/26 mg or 49 mg/51 mg tablet twice a day (one tablet in the morning and one tablet in the evening).

how_to_use.text: Swallow the tablets with a glass of water.
how_to_use.evidence: Swallow the tablets with a glass of water.

how_to_use.text: You can take Entresto with or without food.
how_to_use.evidence: You can take Entresto with or without food.

how_to_use.text: If you forget a dose, take the next one at the scheduled time.
how_to_use.evidence: if you forget to take a dose, you should simply take the next one at the scheduled time.

how_to_use.text: Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.

see_doctor_now.text: Stop taking Entresto and seek immediate medical attention if your face or throat swells.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Stop taking Entresto and seek immediate medical attention if you notice any swelling of the face, lips, tongue and/or throat, which may cause difficulties in breathing or swallowing.

see_doctor_now.text: If you accidentally take too many tablets, contact your doctor immediately.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you have accidentally taken too many Entresto tablets, or if someone else has taken your tablets, contact your doctor immediately.

see_doctor_now.text: If you feel very dizzy or faint, lie down and tell your doctor quickly.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you experience severe dizziness and/or fainting, tell your doctor as quickly as possible and lie down.

side_effects.text: Very common side effects include low blood pressure, high potassium levels, and reduced kidney function.
side_effects.evidence: Very common (may affect more than 1 in 10 people) ... low blood pressure, which can cause symptoms of dizziness and light-headedness (hypotension) ... high level of potassium in the blood, shown in a blood test (hyperkalaemia) ... decreased kidney function (renal impairment)

side_effects.text: Common side effects include cough, dizziness, diarrhoea, tiredness, headache, and feeling sick.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... cough ... dizziness ... diarrhoea ... tiredness (fatigue) ... headache ... feeling sick (nausea)

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: This medicine does not require any special temperature storage conditions.
storage.evidence: This medicine does not require any special temperature storage conditions.

storage.text: Store in the original package in order to protect from moisture.
storage.evidence: Store in the original package in order to protect from moisture.
